newsitem.title: POLAND: Over 4.9 mln Polish NFI units exchanged for shares.
newsitem.headline: Over 4.9 mln Polish NFI units exchanged for shares.

text.p: By Wednesday investors had exchanged 4.946 million of Poland's National Investment Fund (NFI) units into shares of the 15 funds, the National Securities Depository (KDPW) said on Wednesday.
Holders of more than 25.6 million NFI units issued by late 1996 have been able to exchange the units into 15 shares, one in each fund, since May.
The funds' shares began trading on the Warsaw bourse on June 12 and now both the shares and NFI units are traded on the exchange.
The KDPW also said that up to now 15.3 million of the units had been transformed into paperless book-entry form required for bourse trading. -- Warsaw Newsroom +48 22 653 9700
